config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

config.label: Clamp oversized read limits and defer oversized by-id batches
config.description: Clamp oversized read limits and defer oversized by-id batches. Set false to restore strict rejection.

config.label: User-Agent sent on every request to api
config.description: User-Agent sent on every request to api.inaturalist.org. Defaults to the package name, its version, and the repository URL. Keep a contact URL in any override — the published terms ask for identifiable clients.

config.label: Minimum spacing between outbound request starts, in milliseconds
config.description: Minimum spacing between outbound request starts, in milliseconds. The default holds the sustained rate near 54 requests per minute, under the 60 the upstream asks for and well under its 100 ceiling.

config.label: Maximum outbound requests in flight
config.description: Maximum outbound requests in flight. Separate from the start interval: spacing bounds the sustained rate, this bounds the burst so one slow call does not stall the lane.

config.label: Outbound requests allowed per UTC day, counted in-process
config.description: Outbound requests allowed per UTC day, counted in-process. The default sits under the 10,000 per day the upstream asks for, and exhaustion fails loudly rather than degrading silently. The counter is per process and resets on restart.
